caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object resembling a needlework or embroidery piece, with a light brown or beige mesh-like background and scalloped edges. In the center of the mesh, the word "Love" is stitched in a cursive style with multicolored thread, including shades of red, blue, green, yellow, and pink, giving it a floral appearance. The rectangular mesh is bordered on both sides by soft, pinkish fabric panels with subtle shading and slight creases, extending outward horizontally. The fabric on each side features frayed edges. The overall composition is centered on a plain, light-colored background with a small, handwritten signature toward the lower right side that reads "White."
title: Bookmark
